MetricsCalculator.__init__:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Initializes the instance's four classification counter attributes to zero." __init__]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Set the instance attribute true_positives to the constant value 0 as its initial counter state. RESULT self.true_positives]
            [COMMAND Set the instance attribute false_positives to the constant value 0 as its initial counter state. RESULT self.false_positives]
            [COMMAND Set the instance attribute false_negatives to the constant value 0 as its initial counter state. RESULT self.false_negatives]
            [COMMAND Set the instance attribute true_negatives to the constant value 0 as its initial counter state. RESULT self.true_negatives]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
MetricsCalculator.update:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Iterate through paired predicted and true binary labels and increment the corresponding confusion-matrix counter for each recognized label pair." update]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> predicted_labels </REF>: sequence "A sequence of predicted labels iterated in parallel with true_labels using zip."
        <REF> true_labels </REF>: sequence "A sequence of true labels iterated in parallel with predicted_labels using zip."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Iterate over paired values predicted and true from zip(predicted_labels, true_labels), processing only pairs up to the length of the shorter input sequence. RESULT paired_label_iteration]
            [COMMAND Within the loop, if predicted equals 1 and true equals 1, increment self.true_positives by 1. RESULT self.true_positives]
            [COMMAND Within the same loop iteration, otherwise if predicted equals 1 and true equals 0, increment self.false_positives by 1. RESULT self.false_positives]
            [COMMAND Within the same loop iteration, otherwise if predicted equals 0 and true equals 1, increment self.false_negatives by 1. RESULT self.false_negatives]
            [COMMAND Within the same loop iteration, otherwise if predicted equals 0 and true equals 0, increment self.true_negatives by 1. RESULT self.true_negatives]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: Within a loop iteration, if the paired values do not match any of the four explicit binary combinations (1,1), (1,0), (0,1), or (0,0).]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Do not increment any confusion-matrix counter for that iteration. RESULT no_counter_update]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
MetricsCalculator.precision:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Updates the metric state with predicted and true labels, then returns precision as true positives divided by predicted positives, or 0.0 when the denominator is zero." precision]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> predicted_labels </REF>: data "Predicted labels passed to the state update method."
        <REF> true_labels </REF>: data "Ground-truth labels passed to the state update method."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: float "The precision value computed from the updated true positive and false positive counts, or 0.0 if their sum is zero."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Call self.update with predicted_labels and true_labels to propagate the inputs into the object's metric state and apply any side effects defined by update. RESULT updated_metric_state]
            [COMMAND Compute the denominator as self.true_positives plus self.false_positives using the current state after the update call. RESULT predicted_positive_count]
            [COMMAND If predicted_positive_count equals 0, return 0.0 immediately as the precision value. RESULT result]
            [COMMAND Return self.true_positives divided by predicted_positive_count. RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: The sum of self.true_positives and self.false_positives is exactly 0 after the update call.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return 0.0 immediately instead of performing division. RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
MetricsCalculator.recall:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Updates metric counts from the predicted and true labels, returns 0.0 when the recall denominator is zero, otherwise returns true positives divided by true positives plus false negatives." recall]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> predicted_labels </REF>: unknown "Predicted label data passed to the update step."
        <REF> true_labels </REF>: unknown "Ground-truth label data passed to the update step."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: float "Recall value, or 0.0 when the denominator is zero."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Call the internal update step with predicted_labels and true_labels to refresh the object's metric state. RESULT self.update(predicted_labels, true_labels)]
            [COMMAND Check whether self.true_positives plus self.false_negatives is exactly 0. RESULT denominator_is_zero]
            [COMMAND If the denominator is zero, return 0.0 immediately. RESULT 0.0]
            [COMMAND Otherwise compute and return self.true_positives divided by self.true_positives plus self.false_negatives. RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: self.true_positives plus self.false_negatives equals 0]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return 0.0 to avoid division by zero. RESULT 0.0]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
MetricsCalculator.f1_score:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Compute the F1 score from predicted and true labels by updating internal state, deriving precision and recall, returning 0.0 when their sum is zero, and otherwise returning the harmonic mean formula." f1_score]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self </REF>: object "Instance providing update, precision, and recall methods."
        <REF> predicted_labels </REF>: unknown "Predicted labels passed to update, precision, and recall."
        <REF> true_labels </REF>: unknown "Ground truth labels passed to update, precision, and recall."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: float "The computed F1 score, or 0.0 when precision plus recall equals 0.0."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Update the internal state using predicted_labels and true_labels. RESULT self.update(predicted_labels, true_labels)]
            [COMMAND Compute precision from predicted_labels and true_labels using the current instance. RESULT precision]
            [COMMAND Compute recall from predicted_labels and true_labels using the current instance. RESULT recall]
            [COMMAND If precision plus recall equals 0.0, return 0.0 immediately. RESULT 0.0]
            [COMMAND Otherwise, return (2 * precision * recall) divided by (precision + recall). RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
MetricsCalculator.accuracy:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Update the confusion-matrix counts from the provided labels, then return accuracy as the ratio of correct predictions to total predictions, defaulting to 0.0 when the total count is zero." accuracy]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> predicted_labels </REF>: data "Predicted labels used to update the instance confusion-matrix counts."
        <REF> true_labels </REF>: data "True labels used to update the instance confusion-matrix counts."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: float "The computed accuracy value, or 0.0 if the total number of counted outcomes is zero."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Call self.update with predicted_labels and true_labels to refresh the instance true_positives, true_negatives, false_positives, and false_negatives counts. RESULT updated_counts]
            [COMMAND Compute total as self.true_positives + self.true_negatives + self.false_positives + self.false_negatives. RESULT total]
            [COMMAND If total is not equal to 0, return (self.true_positives + self.true_negatives) divided by total. RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: total is equal to 0]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return 0.0 immediately. RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
